exactSourceInput:
AM chaos notes.

CREW CONTRACT
SkyLink holds **M210–M215** quiet wing tonight (inbound ~22:40 delayed from original 05:00 — ops delay). Contractual — **do not sell** these six to leisure walk-ins. Reservations chat suggested “release two for walk-ins” — **DM says no** until SkyLink written release.

Meanwhile leisure arrival **Mr Patel** was showing system allocation **M212** — that is inside crew block. He **cannot** stay on M212. Need reallocate / clarify on Main sellable stock — do **not** invent CX without checking annex board (annex almost full).

HK
M216 / M217 clean. M218 vacant dirty.

PAYMENT
Patel prepaid — no collect.

NOISE
Someone wrote “sell M214 — empty on rack” — ignore; still crew hold.
